item.title: The Knot joins OpenAI’s ChatGPT ad test as brands rethink AI visibility
item.description: As OpenAI tests ads in ChatGPT, companies like The Knot are experimenting with conversational placements and AI-native discovery.

item.title: NYFW brands experimented with AI, virtual try-on and smart mirrors
item.description: Including virtual try-on, smart mirrors, cameras tracking items taken off a rack and other forms of AI, brands are integrating new tech into their shows to demonstrate how that tech is affecting the shopping experience.

item.title: J.Crew bets on scarcity with The Rollneck Remix designer collaboration pop-up
item.description: For a brand with more than 100 stores nationwide, choosing not to use them is an unexpected move. That was the case with J.Crew’s launch of The Rollneck Remix — a New York Fashion Week–timed collaboration with five emerging designers — exclusively through a four-day pop-up at 75 Spring Street and online, bypassing its broader retail fleet.

item.title: Beauty Briefing: Why every beauty brand is collaborating with a soda
item.description: Some beauty consumers still haven’t forgotten the smell of their Dr. Pepper Lip Smackers of the 1990s. While Lip Smackers are long gone, thirty years later, there’s a new wave of soda-inspired lip glosses hitting the shelves.

item.title: Fashion brands hope the fall of department stores leads to a ’boutique boom’
item.description: Wholesale may be struggling, but at New York Fashion Week, designers are hoping for a "boutique boom" to revitalize fashion retail.

item.title: Function Health’s new Erewhon smoothie was designed to highlight nutritional gaps and promote telehealth lab testing
item.description: Function Health, the 4-year-old health platform co-founded by longevity expert Mark Hyman, M.D., joined the growing cohort of Erewhon partners today with the launch of a limited-edition bottled smoothie sold in Erewhon stores. The marketing initiative was designed to drive awareness to nutritional deficiencies discovered from the lab tests of Function’s 500,000 telehealth users.

item.title: The NYFW Rundown: Spectacle, sparsity and insights into American fashion
item.description: With guest Mandy Lee (@oldloserinbrooklyn), the Glossy team unpacks NYFW Fall 2026's politics, protest pins and front-loaded schedule.

item.title: Wellness Briefing: SoulCycle taps Loop Earplugs as wellness partnerships trend, plus news
item.description: This week, I checked in with Namita Gupta, director of strategic partnerships at SoulCycle, to learn about the company's newest partnership, with Loop Earplugs, a category disruptor that makes stylish, reusable earplugs that protect the user’s long-term hearing. It’s part of SoulCycle’s aggressive partnership strategy and aligns with a wave of industry collabs driving consumers to new health and wellness offerings in the new year.

item.title: Introducing Glossy Campus, Where beauty and wellness brands partner with the next generation of creators
item.description: Introducing Glossy Campus, a new creator network of beauty and wellness influencers from nationwide universities.

item.title: Audrey Hobert’s relatable lyrics land her an Ilia partnership
item.description: On her 2025 debut album, "Who's the Clown?" 26-year-old Audrey Hobert sings about relatable topics like acne, Amazon Basics and pilates, which made her a Gen-Z favorite. And, with lyrics like, "Now I don't sweat the acne / It's a bitch, but it goes away," she also found a fan — and partner — in the "clean" makeup brand Ilia.
